summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A., an Argentine financial holding company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 2, 2026, reporting a material event notice to Argentina's CNV regarding the payment of the third installment of cash dividends for fiscal year 2025. The dividend, amounting to 13,333,257,333.33 Argentine pesos, was approved at the Ordinary Shareholders' Meeting on April 28, 2026, and follows the payment schedule announced on June 30, 2026. The record date for shareholders is September 7, 2026, with payment effective on September 10, 2026. This represents a scheduled capital return to shareholders under the previously disclosed dividend policy, without unusual events or structural changes requiring special-situations categorization beyond routine capital distribution.
